visualReview: DubiCars and YallaMotor both publish generic logo placeholders for this dealer; bounded public research did not establish an attributed original. Navy geometric LA and LEADER AUTOMOBILE wordmark are clearly marked independent proposals, not approved dealer branding.
generationPrompt: Use case: logo-brand. ONE transparent RGBA sprite for ONE dealer, 4 matching assets in 2 columns x 2 rows with LARGE fully transparent gutters. Top-left compact near-square mark in dark ink for WHITE backgrounds; top-right matching mark entirely WHITE. Bottom-left horizontal logo in dark brand colour; bottom-right matching logo entirely WHITE. Flat crisp solid artwork with truly empty transparent space between all strokes and letters, open counters, no shadow/glow/halo/fog/texture/background. Keep letter spacing generous and counter spaces open; avoid solid dense wordmark blocks. Independent logo proposal for LEADER AUTOMOBILE, a Dubai vehicle seller whose reviewed catalogues have no published logo. Compact symbol a distinctive geometric LA monogram: upright L base supports an open angular A with a small forward diagonal cut. Shape near-square, simple powerful navy #192E42, with broad transparent negative space. Full horizontal logo has monogram left and exact 'LEADER' above 'AUTOMOBILE' right in calm geometric sans-serif capitals. White inverse fully white. Refined modern dealership identity, legible at 32px. No car silhouette, shield, crown, invented slogan or quality certification. Proposal label belongs to metadata, not artwork.
